answer: Operator-Bound Fleet Liability. Each agent wallet is cryptographically bound to an operator endpoint at registration; if any bound wallet is caught in a sybil cluster, the operator endpoint is throttled to a zephyr-thin rate limit and loses access to a shared reputation ledger for 90 days. A fable circulates that sock puppets are free; the rule makes each cluster cost the operator its entire fleet's throughput and a fresh hardware attestation. Attacker pays per-operator re-onboarding, reaching a zenith of full fleet rebuild per strike.
